summary: Iteration 8: Operational Fixes Testing - All features verified. Backend: 21/21 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 validated all operational fixes: 1) HR Smart Folder now correctly includes human_resources, talent_acquisition, and hr functional areas - shows 5 candidates. 2) Soft delete works - DELETE /api/candidates/{id} marks is_deleted=true, candidate disappears from lists but remains in DB. 3) Restore works - POST /api/candidates/{id}/restore (Admin only) removes is_deleted flag. 4) Duplicates detection returns categorized results (high/medium/low confidence) via GET /api/candidates/{id}/duplicates. 5) Restrict candidate works - POST /api/candidates/{id}/restrict with category and reason, full traceability (who, when, why). 6) Unrestrict works - POST /api/candidates/{id}/unrestrict (Admin only). 7) UI shows restriction banner (red) and duplicate alert banner (amber) correctly. 8) Delete and Restrict dialogs work with proper messaging.

TestDuplicateDetection.test_duplicate_confidence_levels: PASS - Duplicate confidence levels correctly categorized
